ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim arising out of (i) any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or deliverables provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right; (iii) TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iv) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

input.comment: [Playbook] We expanded TrueLink's indemnity to cover third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Interface and Services, plus TrueLink's breach of law, Client-data breaches it causes, and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, since as drafted only Client gives a broad indemnity and TrueLink stands behind nothing on IP. Our playbook requires a vendor IP indemnity; we can discuss customary exclusions (Client modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
input.summary: Add IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and misconduct prongs to TrueLink's indemnity in Section 12(b).
